equipment.name: Bodyweight
equipment.description: No equipment needed - just you and a bit of space.

equipment.name: Exercise mat / floor space
equipment.description: A padded mat or a clear patch of floor where you can lie, kneel or sit for floor exercises.

equipment.name: Barbell & plates
equipment.description: A long straight bar (usually 20 kg) loaded with round weight plates, found in the racks or on the lifting platform.

equipment.name: EZ curl bar
equipment.description: A short barbell with a zig-zag bend in the middle that makes curls easier on the wrists.

equipment.name: Dumbbells
equipment.description: Short single-hand weights, usually lined up in pairs on a rack from light to heavy.

equipment.name: Kettlebell
equipment.description: A cast-iron ball with a flat base and a looped handle on top.

equipment.name: Trap bar (hex bar)
equipment.description: A hexagon-shaped bar you step inside, with a handle on each side and plates loaded on both ends.

equipment.name: Flat bench
equipment.description: A padded, flat bench on a metal frame that does not adjust.

equipment.name: Adjustable bench
equipment.description: A padded bench whose backrest can be raised from flat to upright with a pin or ladder.

equipment.name: Preacher curl bench
equipment.description: A small seat with a slanted arm pad in front of it and hooks for a bar, so your upper arms rest on the pad while you curl.

equipment.name: Back extension bench (45 degrees)
equipment.description: An angled frame with a hip pad at the top and ankle rollers at the bottom, so you can hinge forward and raise your upper body.

equipment.name: Squat rack / power rack
equipment.description: A tall steel cage or pair of uprights with J-hooks and safety bars that hold a barbell at shoulder height.

equipment.name: Smith machine
equipment.description: A barbell fixed between two vertical rails so it only moves straight up and down, with hooks you twist to rack it.

equipment.name: Cable station
equipment.description: A tall frame with a pulley you can slide up and down, connected by a cable to a weight stack and fitted with handles or a rope.

equipment.name: Lat pulldown
equipment.description: A seat with thigh pads under a long bar hanging from a high cable that you pull down to your chest.

equipment.name: Seated cable row
equipment.description: A low seat or bench with a foot platform and a handle on a low cable that you pull towards your belly.

equipment.name: Chest-supported row machine
equipment.description: A seated row machine with a chest pad in front of you and handles that you pull back towards your body.

equipment.name: Chest press machine
equipment.description: A seated machine with a back pad and handles at chest height that you push forward; many gyms also have incline and decline versions.

equipment.name: Shoulder press machine
equipment.description: A seated machine with handles beside your shoulders that you press overhead.

equipment.name: Lateral raise machine
equipment.description: A seated machine with padded arms beside your shoulders that you lift out to the sides.

equipment.name: Pec deck / rear delt fly
equipment.description: A seated machine with two swinging arms or handles you bring together in front of you, or open backwards when facing the pad.

equipment.name: Leg press
equipment.description: A large machine with a big foot platform that you push away while seated or reclined.

equipment.name: Hack squat machine
equipment.description: A sled on angled rails with a back pad and shoulder pads; you stand on a large foot platform and squat down along the rails.

equipment.name: Leg extension
equipment.description: A seated machine with a padded roller in front of your shins that you kick up until the legs are straight.

equipment.name: Leg curl
equipment.description: A lying or seated machine with a padded roller at your ankles that you curl towards your glutes.

equipment.name: Calf raise machine
equipment.description: A machine with shoulder pads (or a knee pad when seated) and a small block to stand on with the balls of your feet.

equipment.name: Hip abductor / adductor
equipment.description: A seated machine with pads against your knees that you push apart (abductor) or squeeze together (adductor).

equipment.name: Back extension machine
equipment.description: A seated machine with a pad behind your upper back that you push backwards by straightening your spine.

equipment.name: Assisted pull-up / dip machine
equipment.description: A tall machine with a knee pad or step that pushes you up, with pull-up handles on top and dip handles lower down.

equipment.name: Pull-up bar
equipment.description: A fixed overhead bar - often on top of a rack or mounted on the wall - that you can hang from.

equipment.name: Dip station
equipment.description: Two parallel handles at about hip height, often a tower with a back pad and forearm rests (a 'captain's chair').

equipment.name: Resistance band
equipment.description: Elastic loops or tubes in different colours and strengths, usually hanging near the stretching area.

equipment.name: Medicine ball
equipment.description: A heavy rubber or soft-shell ball (2-10 kg) that you can throw or slam.

equipment.name: Plyo box / step
equipment.description: A sturdy wooden or foam box, or a stack of aerobic steps, to step or jump onto.

equipment.name: Ab wheel
equipment.description: A small wheel with a handle sticking out on each side.

equipment.name: Foam roller
equipment.description: A firm foam cylinder, 30-90 cm long, used for self-massage.

equipment.name: Jump rope
equipment.description: A skipping rope with a handle on each end.

equipment.name: Treadmill
equipment.description: A running machine with a moving belt and a control panel at the front.

equipment.name: Stationary bike
equipment.description: An indoor exercise bike, either upright or recumbent with a backrest.

equipment.name: Elliptical / cross-trainer
equipment.description: A cardio machine with two large foot pedals and moving handles that travel in a smooth oval path.

equipment.name: Rowing machine
equipment.description: A long rail with a sliding seat, foot straps and a handle on a chain or strap in front of a fan or flywheel.

exercises.name: Easy Rowing
exercises.badminton: Raises heart rate and warms hips, back and shoulders together.
instructions: Sit tall, feet strapped, damper around 3-5.
Drive with legs first, then lean back slightly, then pull handle to lower ribs.
Return arms, body, then legs. Keep an easy conversational pace.
exercises.tip: Legs-body-arms on the drive, reverse on the return.
mistakes: Pulling with the arms before the legs have pushed.
Rounding the back and reaching with hunched shoulders.
Rowing hard - it should stay conversational.

exercises.name: Easy Cycling
instructions: Adjust the seat so your knee is slightly bent at the bottom.
Pedal at a comfortable cadence with light resistance.
Gradually build to a light sweat.
exercises.tip: Keep it easy - this is preparation, not a workout.
mistakes: Seat so low that the knees bend sharply at the bottom.
Resistance so high that it turns into a workout.
Rocking the hips from side to side on the saddle.

exercises.name: Treadmill Walk to Jog
instructions: Start with 2 minutes of brisk walking.
Progress to a light jog for the remaining time.
Breathe through the nose if possible.
exercises.tip: Finish feeling warm, not tired.
mistakes: Holding the handrails the whole time.
Jumping straight to jogging speed without the walk.
Overstriding and landing hard on the heels.

exercises.name: Easy Elliptical
instructions: Step on, hold the moving handles and stand tall.
Start at an easy, steady pace with low resistance.
Push and pull the handles so the arms work too, and build to a light sweat.
exercises.tip: Keep the heels down and the weight through the whole foot.
mistakes: Leaning heavily on the handles.
Setting the resistance so high that it becomes a workout.
Staying up on the toes the whole time.

exercises.name: Jump Rope
exercises.badminton: Builds ankle stiffness and light-footed rhythm used in court footwork.
instructions: Hold handles at hip height, elbows close to the body.
Turn the rope from the wrists and jump just high enough to clear it.
Land softly on the balls of your feet.
exercises.tip: Small, quiet jumps.
mistakes: Jumping far higher than needed.
Turning the rope with the whole arm instead of the wrists.
Landing flat-footed and loudly.

exercises.name: Arm Circles
exercises.badminton: Prepares the shoulder for overhead strokes.
instructions: Stand tall with arms out to the sides.
Make small circles forward, gradually getting bigger.
Repeat backwards.
exercises.tip: Keep shoulders down away from your ears.
mistakes: Shrugging the shoulders up to the ears.
Starting with huge, fast circles.
Arching the lower back.

exercises.name: Band Pull-Apart
exercises.badminton: Balances shoulder muscles for healthy overhead smashes.
instructions: Hold a light band at shoulder height, arms straight.
Pull the band apart until it touches your chest, squeezing shoulder blades.
Return slowly.
exercises.tip: Don't shrug - lead with the shoulder blades.
mistakes: Shrugging instead of squeezing the shoulder blades.
Using a band so strong that the elbows bend.
Letting the band snap back.

exercises.name: Band External Rotation
exercises.badminton: Key injury-prevention drill for the hitting shoulder.
instructions: Anchor a band at elbow height and stand side-on.
Keep elbow at 90 degrees pinned to your side.
Rotate the forearm outward, then return slowly. Repeat both sides.
exercises.tip: A rolled towel under the elbow keeps it in place.
mistakes: Letting the elbow drift away from the side.
Twisting the torso to move the band.
Using a band that is too strong.

exercises.name: Scapular Push-Up
instructions: Start in a high plank with straight arms.
Let your chest sink between the shoulder blades.
Push the floor away to spread the shoulder blades apart.
exercises.tip: Arms stay straight - only the shoulder blades move.
mistakes: Bending the elbows so it becomes a push-up.
Letting the hips sag.
Rushing through tiny, sloppy reps.

exercises.name: Cat-Cow
instructions: Kneel on hands and knees.
Round your back up towards the ceiling, tucking chin.
Then drop the belly and lift chest and tailbone.
exercises.tip: Move slowly with your breath.
mistakes: Moving only the neck instead of the whole spine.
Rushing instead of moving with the breath.
Rocking the hips back and forth instead of curling the back.

exercises.name: World's Greatest Stretch
exercises.badminton: Opens hips and upper back for deep lunges and rotational strokes.
instructions: Step into a long lunge, place both hands inside the front foot.
Drop the inside elbow towards the floor.
Rotate and reach that arm to the ceiling. Alternate sides.
exercises.tip: Keep the back knee off the floor if you can.
mistakes: Taking a short step so the hips barely stretch.
Rotating only the arm instead of the upper back.
Letting the front knee cave inwards.

exercises.name: Open Book Rotation
exercises.badminton: Improves trunk rotation for powerful clears and smashes.
instructions: Lie on your side, knees bent at 90 degrees, arms straight in front.
Open the top arm like a book, rotating your chest to the ceiling.
Follow the hand with your eyes; return. Do both sides.
exercises.tip: Keep the knees stacked together.
mistakes: Letting the knees come apart as you rotate.
Forcing the arm to the floor through pain.
Holding the breath.

exercises.name: Inchworm
instructions: Stand tall, hinge and place hands on the floor.
Walk the hands out to a plank.
Walk the hands back and stand up.
exercises.tip: Bend the knees as needed to reach the floor.
mistakes: Letting the hips sag in the plank.
Rushing the walk-out.
Locking the knees when the hamstrings are tight.

exercises.name: Leg Swings
exercises.badminton: Prepares hips for lunging and lateral movement.
instructions: Hold a wall or rack for balance.
Swing one leg forward and back, then side to side.
Gradually increase range. Switch legs.
exercises.tip: Stay tall - the movement comes from the hip.
mistakes: Leaning the torso to fake range.
Swinging wildly from the first rep.
Arching the lower back on the backswing.

exercises.name: Bodyweight Squat
instructions: Feet shoulder width, toes slightly out.
Sit down between your heels keeping chest proud.
Stand up by pushing the floor away.
exercises.tip: Knees track over the toes.
mistakes: Knees caving inwards.
Heels lifting off the floor.
Rounding the back at the bottom.

exercises.name: Glute Bridge
exercises.badminton: Wakes up the glutes that power your push-off.
instructions: Lie on your back, knees bent, feet flat.
Squeeze glutes and lift hips until body forms a straight line.
Pause one second, lower with control.
exercises.tip: Push through the heels.
mistakes: Arching the lower back instead of squeezing the glutes.
Pushing through the toes.
Dropping down without control.

exercises.name: Lateral Shuffle
exercises.badminton: Direct transfer to side-to-side court coverage.
instructions: Get into an athletic stance, knees bent.
Shuffle sideways 4-5 steps, then back.
Stay low and don't let the feet cross.
exercises.tip: Push off the trailing leg.
mistakes: Crossing or clicking the feet together.
Standing up tall between steps.
Looking down at the feet.

exercises.name: Cable External Rotation
exercises.badminton: Strengthens the rotator cuff that brakes the hitting arm after every smash.
instructions: Set a handle at elbow height and stand side-on, holding it with the outside hand.
Keep the elbow bent 90 degrees and pinned to your side.
Rotate the forearm out away from your belly, then return slowly. Do both sides.
exercises.tip: Use the lightest plate - this is activation, not strength work.
mistakes: Letting the elbow drift away from the ribs.
Twisting the torso to move the handle.
Choosing a weight that is too heavy.

exercises.name: Wall Slide
exercises.badminton: Grooves clean overhead shoulder movement for clears and smashes.
instructions: Stand with your back against a wall, elbows bent 90 degrees at shoulder height, forearms on the wall.
Slide the arms up as high as you can without the lower back arching.
Slide back down, pulling the shoulder blades down and together.
exercises.tip: Ribs down and lower back flat against the wall.
mistakes: Arching the lower back to get the arms higher.
Shrugging the shoulders up to the ears.
Letting the wrists and elbows come off the wall.

exercises.name: Standing Thoracic Rotation
exercises.badminton: Improves trunk rotation for powerful clears and smashes - no floor needed.
instructions: Stand in a quarter squat or split stance with the hips facing forward.
Cross the arms over your chest or place the hands behind your head.
Rotate the upper back to one side as far as is comfortable, return and alternate.
exercises.tip: Keep the hips still - the turn comes from the mid-back.
mistakes: Turning the hips along with the chest.
Yanking into the end range.
Slouching instead of staying tall.

exercises.name: Standing Hip Circles
exercises.badminton: Opens the hips in every direction for lunges and pivots.
instructions: Stand tall next to a rack or wall and hold it for balance.
Lift one knee to hip height, open it out to the side and sweep it behind you in a big circle.
Reverse the direction, then switch legs.
exercises.tip: Slow, big circles - the standing leg and torso stay still.
mistakes: Leaning the torso to make the circle bigger.
Rushing small, sloppy circles.
Letting the standing knee wobble.

exercises.name: Scapular Pull-Up
instructions: Hang from a pull-up bar with straight arms, hands shoulder-width apart.
Without bending the elbows, pull the shoulder blades down so the body rises a few centimetres.
Lower slowly back to a relaxed hang.
exercises.tip: Think "shoulders away from the ears" - the arms stay straight.
mistakes: Bending the elbows so it becomes a pull-up.
Swinging the legs.
Dropping into the bottom without control.

exercises.name: Dynamic Chest Opener
exercises.badminton: Opens the chest and shoulders for a full racket backswing.
instructions: Stand tall with the arms out in front at shoulder height.
Swing the arms open wide until you feel a light stretch across the chest.
Swing them back to cross in front of you, alternating which arm is on top.
exercises.tip: Swing smoothly and let the range build over the reps.
mistakes: Flinging the arms hard into the end range.
Arching the lower back as the arms open.
Shrugging the shoulders.

exercises.name: Knee-to-Wall Ankle Rocks
exercises.badminton: Ankle mobility for deep lunges and low, stable landings.
instructions: Stand facing a wall or rack in a short split stance, the front toes a hand-width from it.
Keeping the front heel down, drive the knee forward over the toes towards the wall.
Rock back and repeat, then switch legs.
exercises.tip: Move the foot back a little once the knee touches easily.
mistakes: Letting the front heel lift.
Letting the knee cave inwards instead of tracking over the toes.
Bouncing hard into the end range.

exercises.name: Barbell Bench Press
instructions: Lie with eyes under the bar, feet flat, shoulder blades pinched.
Grip slightly wider than shoulders, unrack with straight arms.
Lower to mid-chest with elbows ~45 degrees, press back up.
exercises.tip: Use safety bars or a spotter when going heavy.
mistakes: Bouncing the bar off the chest.
Flaring the elbows straight out to the sides.
Lifting the hips off the bench.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Bench Press
instructions: Sit with dumbbells on thighs, lie back and bring them to chest level.
Press up until arms are straight above the chest.
Lower slowly until a stretch in the chest.
exercises.tip: Shoulder blades back and down throughout.
mistakes: Flaring the elbows and dropping the dumbbells too low.
Clanking the dumbbells together at the top.
Losing the shoulder-blade squeeze.

exercises.name: Incline Dumbbell Press
instructions: Set bench to 30 degrees.
Press dumbbells up from upper chest.
Lower under control to a deep stretch.
exercises.tip: A low incline keeps the focus on the upper chest.
mistakes: Setting the bench so steep it becomes a shoulder press.
Arching the back off the bench.
Pressing the dumbbells forward instead of up.

exercises.name: Machine Chest Press
instructions: Adjust the seat so handles are at mid-chest.
Press forward until arms are nearly straight.
Return slowly until you feel a chest stretch.
exercises.tip: Great beginner option - stable and easy to load.
mistakes: Seat height wrong, so the handles miss mid-chest.
Letting the weight stack slam between reps.
Rolling the shoulders forward off the pad.

exercises.name: Smith Machine Incline Press
instructions: Place a bench at 30 degrees under the Smith bar.
Unhook and lower to the upper chest.
Press up without locking out hard.
exercises.tip: Set the safety stops just above your chest.
mistakes: Bench in the wrong spot, so the bar lands on the neck or belly.
Forgetting to set the safety stops.
Bouncing the bar at the bottom.

exercises.name: Smith Machine Bench Press
instructions: Place a flat bench under the Smith bar so the bar lowers to mid-chest.
Unhook the bar with a twist of the wrists, shoulder blades pinched.
Lower to the chest with elbows about 45 degrees and press back up.
exercises.tip: Set the safety stops just above your chest.
mistakes: Bench in the wrong spot, so the bar comes down on the neck or belly.
Flaring the elbows out wide.
Bouncing the bar off the chest.

exercises.name: Push-Up
exercises.badminton: Builds pressing strength with core stability.
instructions: Hands slightly wider than shoulders, body in a straight line.
Lower until your chest nearly touches the floor.
Push back up, keeping hips in line.
exercises.tip: Elevate your hands on a bench to make it easier.
mistakes: Hips sagging or piking up.
Elbows flaring straight out.
Half reps that stop far above the floor.

exercises.name: Seated Dumbbell Shoulder Press
exercises.badminton: Strengthens the overhead position used in clears and smashes.
instructions: Set bench upright, dumbbells at shoulder height, palms forward.
Press overhead until arms are straight.
Lower back to ear level with control.
exercises.tip: Ribs down - avoid arching the lower back.
mistakes: Arching the lower back off the bench.
Lowering only halfway.
Banging the dumbbells together overhead.

exercises.name: Machine Shoulder Press
instructions: Adjust seat so handles start at shoulder height.
Press up until arms are almost straight.
Lower slowly.
exercises.tip: Keep your back against the pad.
mistakes: Seat so low that the handles start below the shoulders.
Lifting the back off the pad.
Locking the elbows hard at the top.

exercises.name: Half-Kneeling Landmine Press
exercises.badminton: Shoulder-friendly single-arm press that trains trunk stability.
instructions: Wedge one end of a barbell in a corner or landmine.
Kneel on the same-side knee as the working arm.
Press the bar up and forward, then lower. Do both arms.
exercises.tip: Squeeze the glute of the down knee.
mistakes: Leaning back to finish the press.
Letting the hips drift forward.
Pressing straight up instead of up and forward.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Lateral Raise
instructions: Stand tall with light dumbbells at your sides.
Raise arms out to shoulder height with a slight elbow bend.
Lower slowly over 2-3 seconds.
exercises.tip: Lead with the elbows, not the hands.
mistakes: Swinging the weights with the body.
Shrugging the dumbbells up past shoulder height.
Choosing dumbbells that are too heavy.

exercises.name: Cable Lateral Raise
instructions: Set a handle at the lowest position, stand side-on.
Raise the far arm out to shoulder height.
Lower slowly. Do both sides.
exercises.tip: Constant tension makes light weights effective.
mistakes: Leaning away from the cable to cheat the weight up.
Bending the elbow more as you lift.
Letting the handle drop quickly.

exercises.name: Pec Deck Fly
instructions: Adjust seat so handles are at chest height.
Bring handles together in a hugging motion.
Return slowly to a comfortable stretch.
exercises.tip: Keep a soft bend in the elbows.
mistakes: Seat too low, so the shoulders roll forward.
Over-stretching far behind the body.
Letting the plates slam on the return.

exercises.name: Cable Chest Fly
instructions: Set pulleys at shoulder height and step forward.
Bring handles together in front of your chest.
Open back up slowly.
exercises.tip: Think of hugging a big tree.
mistakes: Bending and straightening the elbows like a press.
Going so heavy that you lose balance.
Over-stretching the arms far behind you.

exercises.name: Cable Triceps Pushdown
instructions: Attach a rope or bar at the top pulley.
Elbows pinned to your sides, push down until arms are straight.
Return until forearms are just above parallel.
exercises.tip: Only the forearms move.
mistakes: Elbows drifting forward and back.
Leaning over the bar to use body weight.
Stopping short of straight arms.

exercises.name: Overhead Dumbbell Triceps Extension
instructions: Hold one dumbbell with both hands overhead.
Lower it behind your head by bending the elbows.
Extend back up.
exercises.tip: Keep elbows pointing forward.
mistakes: Elbows flaring out wide.
Arching the lower back.
Dropping the weight fast behind the head.

exercises.name: Cable Overhead Triceps Extension
instructions: Attach a rope to a low pulley and face away from the machine in a staggered stance.
Hold the rope behind your head with the elbows pointing forward.
Extend the arms overhead, then let the rope travel back behind the head slowly.
exercises.tip: Keep the elbows close to your head.
mistakes: Elbows flaring out wide.
Arching the lower back.
Moving the shoulders instead of just the elbows.

exercises.name: Bench Dip
instructions: Hands on the bench edge behind you, legs out in front.
Lower by bending elbows to about 90 degrees.
Press back up.
exercises.tip: Bend the knees to make it easier.
mistakes: Dipping so deep the front of the shoulder strains.
Letting the hips drift away from the bench.
Shrugging the shoulders up.

exercises.name: Assisted Dip
instructions: Select assistance weight (more weight = easier).
Lower until upper arms are about parallel to the floor.
Press up to straight arms.
exercises.tip: Progress by reducing the assistance.
mistakes: Going too deep too soon.
Shrugging and rolling the shoulders forward.
Picking so little assistance that form breaks.

exercises.name: Medicine Ball Chest Pass
exercises.badminton: Develops explosive upper-body power for fast racket speed.
instructions: Stand facing a wall, ball at chest.
Explosively push the ball into the wall.
Catch and reset before the next rep.
exercises.tip: Every rep at maximum speed - quality over fatigue.
mistakes: Using a ball so heavy that the throw is slow.
Not resetting between reps.
Throwing with the arms only, no leg drive.

exercises.name: Explosive Incline Push-Up
exercises.badminton: Builds fast pushing power for racket speed - no medicine ball needed.
instructions: Put your hands on the edge of a sturdy bench (or a Smith bar at hip height), body in a straight line.
Lower the chest to the bench under control.
Push away as fast as possible so the hands leave the bench for a moment, catch softly and reset.
exercises.tip: Every rep fast and crisp - end the set when the speed drops.
mistakes: Letting the hips sag during the push.
Catching with locked elbows.
Using a bench that can slide or tip.

exercises.name: Explosive Cable Punch
exercises.badminton: Links leg drive, trunk rotation and arm speed like a fast push or drive shot.
instructions: Set a handle at chest height, face away from the machine in a staggered stance with the handle at your chest.
Punch the handle forward explosively, turning slightly through the hips and trunk.
Return under control and reset before each rep. Do both arms.
exercises.tip: Light weight, maximum speed.
mistakes: Using a weight so heavy that the punch gets slow.
Letting the cable yank the arm back.
Pushing with the arm only, without leg and hip drive.

exercises.name: Incline Machine Chest Press
instructions: Sit in the incline press machine and set the seat so the handles start level with your upper chest.
Press up and away until the arms are nearly straight.
Lower slowly until you feel a stretch across the upper chest.
exercises.tip: Keep the shoulder blades pinned back against the pad.
mistakes: Letting the shoulders roll forward off the pad.
Locking the elbows hard at the top.
Letting the weight stack slam between reps.

exercises.name: Decline Machine Chest Press
instructions: Sit in the decline press machine with the handles level with your lower chest.
Press forward and slightly down until the arms are nearly straight.
Return slowly until you feel a stretch in the chest.
exercises.tip: A shoulder-friendly way to load the chest heavily.
mistakes: Arching the lower back off the pad.
Bouncing out of the bottom position.
Shrugging the shoulders up.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Chest Fly
instructions: Lie on a flat bench with the dumbbells pressed above your chest, palms facing each other.
With a soft bend in the elbows, open the arms in a wide arc until you feel a chest stretch.
Bring the dumbbells back together over the chest as if hugging a barrel.
exercises.tip: Go lighter than you think - the stretch does the work.
mistakes: Bending and straightening the elbows so it becomes a press.
Lowering the dumbbells far below the bench.
Clanking the dumbbells together at the top.

exercises.name: High-to-Low Cable Fly
instructions: Set both pulleys above head height and step forward into a staggered stance.
With soft elbows, sweep the handles down and together in front of your hips.
Let the arms travel back up and out slowly to a comfortable stretch.
exercises.tip: Biases the lower chest - lean the torso slightly forward.
mistakes: Pressing the handles instead of sweeping them in an arc.
Using so much weight that the body rocks.
Letting the arms fly back behind the shoulders.

exercises.name: Low-to-High Cable Fly
instructions: Set both pulleys at the lowest position and stand between them in a staggered stance.
With soft elbows, sweep the handles up and together to upper-chest height.
Lower them slowly back out to the sides.
exercises.tip: Biases the upper chest - think of scooping upwards.
mistakes: Lifting the hands above the face.
Bending the elbows more and more each rep.
Shrugging the shoulders as the hands rise.

exercises.name: Parallel Bar Dip
instructions: Support yourself on straight arms between the bars, shoulders pressed down.
Bend the elbows to lower until the upper arms are about parallel to the floor.
Press back up to straight arms.
exercises.tip: Use the assisted dip machine until you can do 8 clean reps.
mistakes: Dropping lower than the shoulders tolerate.
Shrugging the shoulders up to the ears.
Swinging the legs for momentum.

exercises.name: Incline Barbell Bench Press
instructions: Set an adjustable bench to about 30 degrees in a rack and lie with your eyes under the bar.
Unrack with a grip slightly wider than the shoulders and lower the bar to the upper chest.
Press back up until the bar is over the shoulders.
exercises.tip: Set the safety bars - an incline bar is hard to dump.
mistakes: Setting the bench so steep that it becomes a shoulder press.
Bouncing the bar off the chest.
Flaring the elbows straight out to the sides.

exercises.name: Incline Push-Up
instructions: Place your hands on the edge of a sturdy bench or box, slightly wider than the shoulders.
Walk the feet back until the body is a straight line, then lower the chest to the edge.
Push back up, keeping the hips in line.
exercises.tip: The higher the surface, the easier it is - a racked Smith bar works too.
mistakes: Letting the hips sag.
Flaring the elbows straight out.
Stopping halfway down.

exercises.name: Seated Arnold Press
instructions: Sit on an upright bench with the dumbbells in front of your shoulders, palms facing you.
Press up while rotating the palms to face forward at the top.
Reverse the rotation as you lower back to the start.
exercises.tip: One smooth movement - rotate while you press.
mistakes: Arching the lower back off the bench.
Rushing the rotation and losing control.
Cutting the range short at the bottom.

exercises.name: Standing Barbell Overhead Press
instructions: Unrack the bar at collarbone height, hands just outside the shoulders, feet hip-width apart.
Brace the abs and glutes and press the bar straight up, moving the head back slightly to let it pass.
Finish with the bar over the middle of the feet, then lower it to the collarbones.
exercises.tip: Squeeze glutes and abs so the lower back does not arch.
mistakes: Leaning back so it turns into an incline press.
Pressing the bar forward around the face.
Flaring the ribs and arching the lower back.

exercises.name: Smith Machine Shoulder Press
instructions: Set an upright bench under the Smith bar so the bar lowers just in front of your face.
Unhook the bar with the hands slightly wider than the shoulders.
Lower to chin height and press back up without locking out hard.
exercises.tip: Set the safety stops at chin height.
mistakes: Bench too far back, so the bar comes down on the face.
Arching the lower back off the pad.
Lowering only a few centimetres.

exercises.name: Machine Lateral Raise
instructions: Adjust the seat so your shoulders line up with the pivot points and the pads rest on the outside of the arms.
Raise the arms out to the sides to shoulder height, leading with the elbows.
Lower slowly over 2-3 seconds.
exercises.tip: Stable and easy to learn - ideal for taking side delts close to failure.
mistakes: Seat at the wrong height, so the shoulders miss the pivot.
Shrugging the shoulders up.
Letting the stack slam down.

exercises.name: Cable Y-Raise
exercises.badminton: Strengthens the shoulder through the overhead range used for clears and smashes.
instructions: Set both pulleys at the lowest position, cross the cables and hold the left handle in the right hand and vice versa.
Step back and raise the arms up and out into a Y to just above shoulder height, thumbs up.
Lower slowly until the hands cross in front of the hips.
exercises.tip: Very light weight - feel the side of the shoulders, not the neck.
mistakes: Shrugging the shoulders towards the ears.
Arching the lower back to lift higher.
Going so heavy that the arms bend.

exercises.name: Lean-Away Dumbbell Lateral Raise
instructions: Hold a rack upright with one hand, feet close to it, and lean away with a straight arm.
With a dumbbell in the free hand, raise the arm out to the side to shoulder height.
Lower slowly, finish all reps, then switch sides.
exercises.tip: The lean keeps tension at the bottom, where normal raises are easy.
mistakes: Swinging the dumbbell up.
Shrugging the working shoulder.
Leaning so far that you lose your grip on the post.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Scaption Raise
instructions: Stand tall with light dumbbells at your sides, thumbs pointing forward.
Raise the arms in a slight V, about 30 degrees in front of the body, up to shoulder height.
Lower slowly over 2-3 seconds.
exercises.tip: A shoulder-friendly raise - the thumbs-up angle gives the joint more room.
mistakes: Raising straight out in front like a front raise.
Shrugging the dumbbells up.
Swinging with the hips.

exercises.name: Cable Upright Row
instructions: Attach a straight bar to the low pulley and hold it with a grip at least shoulder-width apart.
Pull the bar up along the body to lower-chest height, leading with the elbows.
Lower slowly to straight arms.
exercises.tip: Stop at lower-chest height - pulling higher pinches the shoulders.
mistakes: Pulling the bar up to the chin.
Using a narrow grip.
Leaning back and swinging the weight.

exercises.name: EZ-Bar Skull Crusher
instructions: Lie on a flat bench holding the EZ bar over your chest on the narrow angled grips.
Bend only the elbows to lower the bar towards the forehead or just behind the head.
Extend the elbows to bring the bar back up.
exercises.tip: Let the bar drift slightly behind the head for a bigger triceps stretch.
mistakes: Elbows flaring out wide.
Moving the upper arms so it becomes a press.
Lowering quickly towards the face.

exercises.name: Close-Grip Bench Press
instructions: Lie under the bar and grip it about shoulder-width apart.
Lower the bar to the lower chest with the elbows tucked close to the body.
Press back up to straight arms.
exercises.tip: Shoulder-width is close enough - a very narrow grip strains the wrists.
mistakes: Gripping so narrow that the wrists bend.
Flaring the elbows out.
Bouncing the bar off the chest.

exercises.name: Smith Machine Close-Grip Bench Press
instructions: Place a flat bench under the Smith bar so it lowers to your lower chest.
Grip shoulder-width, unhook the bar and lower it with the elbows close to the body.
Press back up to straight arms.
exercises.tip: Set the safety stops just above your chest.
mistakes: Bench in the wrong spot, so the bar lands on the neck or belly.
Gripping too narrow.
Flaring the elbows out.

exercises.name: Rope Triceps Pushdown
instructions: Attach a rope to the high pulley and hold the ends with the elbows at your sides.
Push down and spread the rope ends apart at the bottom until the arms are straight.
Return slowly until the forearms are just above parallel.
exercises.tip: Spread the rope at the bottom for an extra squeeze.
mistakes: Elbows drifting forward and back.
Leaning over the rope to use body weight.
Letting the hands come up above the chest.

exercises.name: Single-Arm Cable Pushdown
instructions: Attach a single handle to the high pulley and hold it with one hand, elbow pinned to your side.
Extend the arm down until it is straight.
Return slowly. Finish all reps, then switch arms.
exercises.tip: Try an underhand grip now and then for variety.
mistakes: Elbow drifting away from the side.
Twisting the torso to push.
Rushing the return.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Triceps Kickback
instructions: Support one knee and hand on a bench, back flat, the working upper arm parallel to the floor.
Straighten the elbow until the arm points straight back.
Lower slowly. Finish all reps, then switch arms.
exercises.tip: Keep the upper arm still - only the forearm moves.
mistakes: Swinging the dumbbell with the shoulder.
Letting the upper arm drop.
Using a dumbbell that is too heavy.

exercises.name: Lat Pulldown
exercises.badminton: Strong lats power overhead strokes.
instructions: Grip the bar slightly wider than shoulders, thighs under the pad.
Pull the bar to your upper chest, elbows down and back.
Let it rise slowly until arms are straight.
exercises.tip: Lean back slightly, don't swing.
mistakes: Leaning far back and swinging the weight.
Pulling the bar behind the neck.
Letting the bar yank the arms up.

exercises.name: Neutral-Grip Lat Pulldown
instructions: Attach a close neutral-grip (V) handle and sit with the thighs under the pad.
Pull the handle to your upper chest, driving the elbows down to the ribs.
Let it rise slowly until the arms are straight.
exercises.tip: Shoulder-friendly grip - bring the chest up to meet the handle.
mistakes: Leaning far back and swinging.
Shrugging the shoulders at the top.
Stopping short of straight arms.

exercises.name: Assisted Pull-Up
instructions: Kneel on the pad and grip the handles.
Pull until your chin passes the handles.
Lower to full arm extension.
exercises.tip: Progress by reducing the assistance.
mistakes: Choosing so much assistance that it is effortless.
Half reps without straightening the arms.
Kicking or swinging to get up.

exercises.name: Band-Assisted Pull-Up
instructions: Loop a band over the bar and place a knee or foot in it.
Pull up until your chin clears the bar.
Lower under control.
exercises.tip: Use a lighter band as you get stronger.
mistakes: Letting the band fling you up.
Cutting the range short at the bottom.
Losing control on the way down.

exercises.name: Seated Cable Row
exercises.badminton: Balances pressing and supports posture.
instructions: Sit tall with knees slightly bent.
Pull the handle to your belly, squeezing shoulder blades.
Extend arms slowly without rounding your back.
exercises.tip: Chest up, no rocking.
mistakes: Rocking the torso back and forth.
Shrugging the shoulders up.
Rounding the back on the stretch.

exercises.name: Single-Arm Cable Row
instructions: Set a handle at chest height and stand in a split stance, opposite foot forward.
Row the handle to your side with the elbow close to the ribs.
Reach forward slowly to a full stretch. Do both sides.
exercises.tip: Keep the hips and chest square to the machine.
mistakes: Twisting the torso to pull the weight.
Shrugging the working shoulder.
Rushing the return.

exercises.name: One-Arm Dumbbell Row
instructions: Support one knee and hand on a bench, back flat.
Row the dumbbell towards your hip.
Lower to a full stretch. Do both sides.
exercises.tip: Pull the elbow back, not up.
mistakes: Twisting the torso to lift the weight.
Pulling towards the chest instead of the hip.
Rounding the back.

exercises.name: Chest-Supported Dumbbell Row
instructions: Lie face-down on a bench set to 30-45 degrees.
Row dumbbells up, squeezing shoulder blades.
Lower until arms are straight.
exercises.tip: Back-friendly - the bench does the stabilising.
mistakes: Lifting the chest off the pad.
Shrugging instead of rowing.
Going too heavy to pause at the top.

exercises.name: Barbell Bent-Over Row
instructions: Hinge forward to ~45 degrees with a flat back.
Row the bar to your lower ribs.
Lower under control.
exercises.tip: Brace your core - your back angle should not change.
mistakes: Standing up a bit more with every rep.
Rounding the lower back.
Jerking the bar up with the hips.

exercises.name: Inverted Row
instructions: Set a Smith bar at waist height and hang underneath it.
Keep the body straight and pull your chest to the bar.
Lower slowly.
exercises.tip: Raise the bar to make it easier.
mistakes: Letting the hips sag.
Reaching with the chin instead of pulling the chest to the bar.
Setting the bar too low for your level.

exercises.name: Cable Face Pull
exercises.badminton: Top shoulder-health exercise for overhead athletes.
instructions: Set a rope at face height.
Pull towards your forehead, splitting the rope and rotating hands back.
Return slowly.
exercises.tip: Finish like a double-biceps pose.
mistakes: Using too much weight and leaning back.
Pulling to the chest instead of the face.
Letting the elbows drop below the hands.

exercises.name: Band Face Pull
exercises.badminton: Shoulder health for overhead strokes.
instructions: Anchor a band at face height.
Pull towards your face, elbows high, rotating hands back.
Return slowly.
exercises.tip: Squeeze the shoulder blades at the end.
mistakes: Letting the elbows drop low.
Shrugging the shoulders.
Letting the band snap back.

exercises.name: Reverse Dumbbell Fly
instructions: Hinge forward with light dumbbells hanging below.
Raise arms out to the sides with soft elbows.
Lower slowly.
exercises.tip: Use light weights and feel the back of the shoulders.
mistakes: Swinging the weights with momentum.
Standing up a little more each rep.
Shrugging instead of opening the arms.

exercises.name: Reverse Pec Deck
instructions: Sit facing the pad, handles at shoulder height.
Sweep arms back in an arc.
Return slowly.
exercises.tip: Keep the chest on the pad.
mistakes: Chest coming off the pad.
Going heavy and shrugging.
Bending the elbows more and more.

exercises.name: Straight-Arm Pulldown
exercises.badminton: Mimics the downward arm path of a smash.
instructions: Hold a bar or rope at the high pulley, arms straight.
Sweep the handle down to your thighs.
Return slowly overhead.
exercises.tip: Hinge slightly and keep arms long.
mistakes: Bending the elbows so it becomes a pushdown.
Rounding the back.
Going so heavy that the body rocks.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Biceps Curl
instructions: Stand with dumbbells at your sides, palms forward.
Curl up without moving the elbows.
Lower slowly.
exercises.tip: No swinging - control the descent.
mistakes: Swinging the body to lift the weight.
Elbows drifting forward.
Dropping the weight instead of lowering it.

exercises.name: Hammer Curl
exercises.badminton: Forearm and grip strength help racket control.
instructions: Hold dumbbells with palms facing each other.
Curl up keeping the neutral grip.
Lower slowly.
exercises.tip: Keep wrists straight.
mistakes: Swinging the body.
Bending the wrists.
Letting the elbows move forward.

exercises.name: Cable Biceps Curl
instructions: Attach a bar at the low pulley.
Curl up with elbows at your sides.
Lower slowly.
exercises.tip: Constant tension the whole way.
mistakes: Leaning back to finish the rep.
Elbows drifting forward.
Stopping short of straight arms.

exercises.name: EZ-Bar Curl
instructions: Grip the angled part of the bar.
Curl up keeping elbows still.
Lower under control.
exercises.tip: Easier on the wrists than a straight bar.
mistakes: Swinging the hips to start the rep.
Elbows moving forward.
Not lowering to straight arms.

exercises.name: Medicine Ball Slam
exercises.badminton: Trains the explosive overhead-to-down motion of a smash.
instructions: Raise the ball overhead, rising onto your toes.
Slam it into the floor as hard as possible, hinging at the hips.
Pick it up and reset.
exercises.tip: Use a non-bouncing slam ball.
mistakes: Rounding the back to pick the ball up.
Throwing with the arms only.
Using a bouncy ball that flies back up.

exercises.name: Cable Overhead Smash Pull
exercises.badminton: Mimics the overhead smash: a fast lat and trunk pull from high behind the head to across the body.
instructions: Set a handle at the top pulley, stand side-on in a split stance and hold it above and behind your head with the hitting hand.
Pull explosively down and across to the opposite hip, rotating the hips and trunk like a smash.
Return slowly to the start and reset. Do both sides.
exercises.tip: Light weight, fast pull, slow return.
mistakes: Bending the elbow so it becomes a pulldown.
Going heavy and losing speed.
Letting the cable whip the arm back up.

exercises.name: Band Overhead Smash
exercises.badminton: Grooves a fast, smash-like overhead-to-down arm path with the trunk turning.
instructions: Anchor a band high (top of a rack or pull-up bar) and stand side-on in a split stance.
Start with the hitting hand above and behind your head, then pull explosively down and across your body.
Return slowly and reset. Do both sides.
exercises.tip: Step further away for more tension - speed matters more than resistance.
mistakes: Pulling slowly with a band that is too strong.
Only moving the arm without turning the trunk.
Letting the band snap the arm back.

exercises.name: Cable Woodchop
exercises.badminton: Rotational power that transfers directly to forehand strokes.
instructions: Set the pulley high, stand side-on.
Pull diagonally down across your body, rotating through hips and trunk.
Return slowly. Do both sides.
exercises.tip: Pivot the back foot like a racket swing.
mistakes: Moving only the arms.
Keeping the feet stuck so the knees twist.
Going so heavy that the trunk loses control.

exercises.name: Underhand Lat Pulldown
instructions: Grip the bar with palms facing you, hands about shoulder-width apart, thighs under the pad.
Pull the bar to your upper chest, driving the elbows down to the ribs.
Let it rise slowly until the arms are straight.
exercises.tip: Extra biceps work - keep the chest up and proud.
mistakes: Leaning far back and swinging.
Shrugging the shoulders as you pull.
Letting the bar yank the arms up.

exercises.name: Close-Grip Lat Pulldown
instructions: Grip the bar overhand with the hands about shoulder-width apart, thighs under the pad.
Pull the bar to the top of your chest, elbows driving down.
Return slowly to straight arms.
exercises.tip: The narrower grip allows a longer pull - control the stretch at the top.
mistakes: Pulling the bar behind the neck.
Swinging the torso.
Cutting the stretch short.

exercises.name: Single-Arm Lat Pulldown
instructions: Attach a single D-handle to the pulldown cable and sit with the thighs under the pad.
Pull the handle down to the side of your chest, driving the elbow towards the hip.
Let it rise slowly to a full stretch. Finish all reps, then switch arms.
exercises.tip: Let the shoulder blade rise at the top for a big lat stretch.
mistakes: Twisting the torso to pull.
Pulling the handle in front of the face instead of to the side.
Rushing the stretch.

exercises.name: Pull-Up
instructions: Hang from the bar with an overhand grip slightly wider than the shoulders.
Pull your chest towards the bar until the chin clears it, elbows driving down.
Lower under control to straight arms.
exercises.tip: Not at 4 reps yet? Use the assisted or band-assisted version.
mistakes: Kipping or swinging the legs.
Half reps that never reach straight arms.
Craning the neck to get the chin over the bar.

exercises.name: Chin-Up
instructions: Hang from the bar with palms facing you, hands about shoulder-width apart.
Pull until the chin clears the bar, keeping the chest up.
Lower slowly to straight arms.
exercises.tip: Usually the first bodyweight pull you master after assisted pull-ups.
mistakes: Swinging or kicking.
Dropping fast into the bottom.
Shrugging the shoulders at the top.

exercises.name: Chest-Supported Machine Row
instructions: Adjust the seat so the handles are at chest height and rest your chest on the pad.
Row the handles back, squeezing the shoulder blades together.
Return slowly until the arms are straight.
exercises.tip: The chest pad takes the lower back out of it - great for heavy rows.
mistakes: Lifting the chest off the pad to heave the weight.
Shrugging instead of rowing.
Letting the weight slam between reps.

exercises.name: Landmine T-Bar Row
instructions: Wedge one end of a barbell in a landmine or corner, straddle it and grip under the loaded end with a V-handle or both hands.
Hinge to about 45 degrees with a flat back and row the plates towards your chest.
Lower under control without letting the back round.
exercises.tip: Smaller plates give a longer range of motion.
mistakes: Rounding the lower back.
Standing more upright every rep.
Jerking the weight up with the hips.

exercises.name: Smith Machine Bent-Over Row
instructions: Set the Smith bar at knee height, grip it slightly wider than the shoulders and hinge forward with a flat back.
Row the bar to your lower ribs, squeezing the shoulder blades.
Lower under control to straight arms.
exercises.tip: The fixed bar path lets you focus on the back - keep the torso angle constant.
mistakes: Rounding the lower back.
Standing up a little more each rep.
Shrugging the bar up instead of rowing.

exercises.name: Bent-Over Dumbbell Row
instructions: Hold the dumbbells and hinge forward to about 45 degrees with soft knees and a flat back.
Row both dumbbells towards the hips, squeezing the shoulder blades.
Lower to straight arms without changing the back angle.
exercises.tip: Brace the abs as if someone is about to poke your belly.
mistakes: Rounding the back.
Swinging the dumbbells up with the hips.
Pulling towards the chest instead of the hips.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Shrug
instructions: Stand tall with heavy dumbbells at your sides.
Lift the shoulders straight up towards the ears.
Pause for a second and lower slowly.
exercises.tip: Straight up and down - no rolling the shoulders.
mistakes: Rolling the shoulders in circles.
Bending the elbows to help.
Pushing the head forward.

exercises.name: Barbell Shrug
instructions: Unrack the bar at mid-thigh height with a shoulder-width overhand grip.
Shrug the shoulders straight up as high as possible.
Pause and lower slowly to a full stretch.
exercises.tip: Set the hooks at mid-thigh so you never have to lift it from the floor.
mistakes: Rolling the shoulders.
Bouncing the bar up with the legs.
Cutting the range short.

exercises.name: Smith Machine Behind-the-Back Shrug
instructions: Stand with your back to the Smith bar set at hip height and grip it behind you, hands shoulder-width apart.
Unhook it and shrug the shoulders straight up and slightly back.
Pause and lower slowly.
exercises.tip: Holding the bar behind you shifts the work towards the middle of the traps.
mistakes: Bending the elbows.
Leaning forward.
Rolling the shoulders.

exercises.name: Cable Shrug
instructions: Attach a straight bar to the low pulley and stand close, holding it at arm's length.
Shrug the shoulders straight up.
Pause and lower slowly to a full stretch.
exercises.tip: The cable keeps tension at the bottom - go slow.
mistakes: Standing so far back that the cable pulls you forward.
Rolling the shoulders.
Bending the elbows.

exercises.name: Cable Rear Delt Fly
exercises.badminton: Builds the back of the shoulder that brakes the arm after every smash.
instructions: Set both pulleys at shoulder height, cross the cables and hold the left cable in the right hand and vice versa.
With soft elbows, pull the arms out and back until they are in line with the body.
Return slowly until the hands cross in front of you.
exercises.tip: Lead with the backs of the hands.
mistakes: Bending the elbows into a row.
Leaning back to move more weight.
Shrugging the shoulders.

exercises.name: Chest-Supported Rear Delt Raise
instructions: Lie face-down on a bench set to about 30 degrees with light dumbbells hanging below.
Raise the arms out to the sides with soft elbows until level with the body.
Lower slowly.
exercises.tip: The bench stops you from swinging - use light weights.
mistakes: Lifting the chest off the bench.
Rowing with bent elbows.
Going too heavy.

exercises.name: EZ-Bar Preacher Curl
instructions: Sit at the preacher bench with the backs of the upper arms flat on the pad, holding the EZ bar on the angled grips.
Curl the bar up until the forearms are nearly vertical.
Lower slowly until the arms are almost straight.
exercises.tip: Stop just short of locking out at the bottom to keep tension and protect the elbows.
mistakes: Dropping the bar fast into the bottom.
Lifting the elbows off the pad.
Leaning back to finish the rep.

exercises.name: Single-Arm Dumbbell Preacher Curl
instructions: Rest the back of one upper arm on the preacher pad with a dumbbell in that hand.
Curl the dumbbell up until the forearm is nearly vertical.
Lower slowly to almost straight. Finish all reps, then switch arms.
exercises.tip: Lower over 3 seconds - the stretched bottom is where the work is.
mistakes: Letting the dumbbell drop at the bottom.
Rolling the shoulder forward to lift.
Letting the elbow slide off the pad.

exercises.name: Incline Dumbbell Curl
instructions: Set a bench to about 45-60 degrees and lie back with the dumbbells hanging straight down.
Curl up without letting the elbows drift forward.
Lower slowly to a full stretch.
exercises.tip: The stretched start makes light weights feel heavy.
mistakes: Bringing the elbows forward.
Lifting the head and shoulders off the bench.
Bouncing out of the stretch.

exercises.name: Cable Rope Hammer Curl
instructions: Attach a rope to the low pulley and hold the ends with palms facing each other.
Curl the rope up with the elbows at your sides.
Lower slowly to straight arms.
exercises.tip: Keep the wrists straight and the thumbs up.
mistakes: Swinging the body.
Elbows drifting forward.
Bending the wrists.

exercises.name: Concentration Curl
instructions: Sit on a bench, lean forward and brace the back of one upper arm against the inside of the thigh.
Curl the dumbbell up towards the shoulder.
Lower slowly to straight. Finish all reps, then switch arms.
exercises.tip: Squeeze at the top and lower over 3 seconds.
mistakes: Pushing the arm up with the thigh.
Swinging the shoulder.
Not lowering all the way.

exercises.name: Bayesian Cable Curl
instructions: Set a handle at the lowest pulley, face away from the machine and step forward so the arm is pulled slightly behind you.
Curl the handle up and forward without letting the elbow drift.
Lower slowly until the arm is straight behind the body. Finish all reps, then switch arms.
exercises.tip: The arm-behind start gives the biceps a big stretch - keep the weight light.
mistakes: Letting the shoulder roll forward.
Swinging the elbow forward to lift.
Using a weight that yanks the arm back.

exercises.name: Barbell Curl
instructions: Stand tall holding a barbell with an underhand, shoulder-width grip.
Curl the bar up without moving the elbows forward.
Lower slowly to straight arms.
exercises.tip: If the wrists complain, switch to the EZ bar.
mistakes: Swinging the hips to start the rep.
Elbows drifting forward.
Leaning back at the top.

exercises.name: Seated Dumbbell Wrist Curl
exercises.badminton: Grip and wrist strength help racket control and protect the elbow.
instructions: Sit on a bench with the forearms on the thighs, palms up and the wrists just past the knees.
Let the dumbbells roll down towards the fingertips, then curl the wrists up as high as possible.
Lower slowly.
exercises.tip: Small movement, high reps - feel the inside of the forearms work.
mistakes: Lifting the forearms off the thighs.
Bouncing the weight.
Going so heavy that the range gets tiny.

exercises.name: Seated Reverse Wrist Curl
exercises.badminton: Strengthens the wrist extensors, a common overuse area in racket sports.
instructions: Sit on a bench with the forearms on the thighs, palms down and the wrists just past the knees.
Lift the backs of the hands up as high as possible.
Lower slowly to a stretch.
exercises.tip: Use very light dumbbells - the wrist extensors are small.
mistakes: Lifting the forearms off the thighs.
Using too much weight.
Rushing the lowering.

exercises.name: Reverse-Grip Barbell Curl
instructions: Hold a barbell with an overhand, shoulder-width grip.
Curl the bar up with the elbows at your sides and the wrists straight.
Lower slowly to straight arms.
exercises.tip: Go lighter than for your normal curl.
mistakes: Letting the wrists bend back.
Swinging the body.
Elbows drifting forward.

exercises.name: Cable Reverse Curl
instructions: Attach a straight bar to the low pulley and hold it with an overhand grip.
Curl up with the elbows pinned to your sides.
Lower slowly to straight arms.
exercises.tip: Knuckles up and wrists straight the whole way.
mistakes: Bending the wrists.
Leaning back.
Elbows moving forward.

exercises.name: Cable Wrist Curl
instructions: Put a bench in front of a low pulley with a straight bar, sit and rest the forearms on the thighs, palms up.
Let the bar roll towards the fingertips, then curl the wrists up.
Lower slowly.
exercises.tip: Constant cable tension - keep the forearms still on the thighs.
mistakes: Lifting the forearms off the thighs.
Jerking the weight.
Going too heavy for full range.

exercises.name: Farmer's Carry
instructions: Pick up a heavy dumbbell in each hand with a flat back.
Walk tall with short, controlled steps, shoulders down and back.
Turn carefully and keep going for the full time; set the weights down with a flat back.
exercises.tip: Grip hard and stay tall - the shoulders should not creep up.
mistakes: Leaning forward or to one side.
Shrugging the shoulders.
Rounding the back when picking up or putting down.

exercises.name: Dead Hang
instructions: Grip a pull-up bar overhand, shoulder-width apart, and step off a box or bench.
Hang with straight arms, shoulders gently pulled away from the ears.
Hold for the full time, then step back down.
exercises.tip: Add time before you add weight.
mistakes: Dropping off instead of stepping down.
Letting the shoulders sag up to the ears.
Swinging.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Pullover
instructions: Lie with your upper back across a flat bench, feet flat, holding one dumbbell with both hands above the chest.
With slightly bent elbows, lower the dumbbell in an arc behind your head until you feel a stretch.
Pull it back over the chest with the lats.
exercises.tip: Keep the hips low and the ribs down.
mistakes: Bending the elbows more as you lower.
Arching the lower back as the weight goes back.
Going so deep that the shoulders pinch.

exercises.name: Bent-Arm Barbell Pullover
instructions: Lie along a flat bench holding a light barbell over your chest with a narrow grip.
Keeping the elbows bent, lower the bar in an arc behind the head until the lats stretch.
Pull it back over the chest.
exercises.tip: Use a light bar - this is a stretch-focused accessory.
mistakes: Bending and straightening the elbows like a skull crusher.
Arching the lower back.
Lowering further than the shoulders allow.

exercises.name: Goblet Squat
exercises.badminton: Builds leg strength and deep-squat mobility for low returns.
instructions: Hold a dumbbell vertically against your chest.
Squat down between your knees, chest tall.
Drive up through the whole foot.
exercises.tip: Elbows go inside the knees at the bottom.
mistakes: Knees caving inwards.
Heels lifting off the floor.
Letting the weight pull the chest forward.

exercises.name: Kettlebell Goblet Squat
instructions: Hold the kettlebell by the horns at your chest.
Squat down keeping the chest up.
Stand by driving the floor away.
exercises.tip: Keep the bell close to your body.
mistakes: Knees caving inwards.
Holding the bell away from the body.
Rounding the back at the bottom.

exercises.name: Barbell Back Squat
instructions: Bar on upper back, feet shoulder width.
Brace, then sit down until thighs are at least parallel.
Drive up keeping chest and hips rising together.
exercises.tip: Set the safety pins just below your bottom position.
mistakes: Skipping the safety pins.
Knees caving inwards on the way up.
Losing the brace so the chest drops.

exercises.name: Smith Machine Squat
instructions: Bar on upper back, feet slightly in front of you.
Squat down under control.
Press back up.
exercises.tip: Set the safety stops before starting.
mistakes: Feet directly under the bar, which overloads the knees.
Forgetting the safety stops.
Not twisting the hooks fully when racking.

exercises.name: Leg Press
instructions: Feet shoulder width in the middle of the platform.
Lower until knees are ~90 degrees without the lower back lifting.
Press up without locking the knees.
exercises.tip: Keep your lower back glued to the pad.
mistakes: Going so deep that the lower back lifts off the pad.
Locking the knees hard at the top.
Pushing through the toes.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Romanian Deadlift
exercises.badminton: Strong hamstrings protect against strains during lunges.
instructions: Hold dumbbells in front of your thighs, soft knees.
Push hips back, sliding weights down your legs with a flat back.
Stop at mid-shin or when you feel a strong stretch; stand up.
exercises.tip: It's a hip hinge, not a squat.
mistakes: Rounding the back.
Squatting down instead of pushing the hips back.
Letting the weights drift away from the legs.

exercises.name: Barbell Romanian Deadlift
instructions: Hold the bar at hip height, soft knees.
Hinge back keeping the bar close to your legs.
Return to standing by squeezing glutes.
exercises.tip: Keep the bar touching your legs.
mistakes: Rounding the back.
Letting the bar drift away from the legs.
Bending the knees into a squat.

exercises.name: Cable Pull-Through
exercises.badminton: Teaches the hip hinge that powers jumps and push-offs.
instructions: Attach a rope to the low pulley, face away and hold it between your legs.
Walk forward a couple of steps, then hinge back with soft knees and a flat back.
Stand tall by squeezing the glutes and driving the hips forward.
exercises.tip: The arms are just hooks - the hips do the work.
mistakes: Squatting down instead of hinging.
Pulling with the arms.
Leaning back at the top.

exercises.name: Kettlebell Swing
exercises.badminton: Explosive hip extension for jumps and push-offs.
instructions: Hike the bell back between your legs with a hinge.
Snap hips forward so the bell floats to chest height.
Let it fall and hinge again.
exercises.tip: Power comes from the hips, not the arms.
mistakes: Squatting instead of hinging.
Lifting the bell with the arms.
Leaning back at the top.

exercises.name: Leg Curl Machine
exercises.badminton: Hamstring injury prevention.
instructions: Adjust so the pad sits just above the heels.
Curl your heels towards your glutes.
Lower slowly over 3 seconds.
exercises.tip: Keep hips down on the pad.
mistakes: Hips lifting off the pad.
Dropping the weight quickly.
Pad sitting on the calves instead of above the heels.

exercises.name: Hamstring Walkout
exercises.badminton: Bodyweight hamstring strength for sprint-and-lunge actions.
instructions: Start in a glute bridge.
Walk the heels out in small steps while keeping hips up.
Walk them back in.
exercises.tip: Only go as far as you can keep hips lifted.
mistakes: Letting the hips drop.
Taking big steps you cannot control.
Arching the lower back.

exercises.name: Leg Extension
instructions: Align knees with the machine pivot.
Extend legs until straight.
Lower slowly.
exercises.tip: Pause briefly at the top.
mistakes: Kicking the weight up with momentum.
Knees not lined up with the machine pivot.
Lifting the hips off the seat.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Reverse Lunge
exercises.badminton: Mirrors the lunge-and-recover pattern at the net.
instructions: Hold dumbbells at your sides.
Step back and lower until both knees are ~90 degrees.
Drive through the front foot to return. Alternate legs.
exercises.tip: Reps are per leg.
mistakes: Stepping back too short, so the front knee shoots forward.
Leaning the torso far forward.
Slamming the back knee into the floor.

exercises.name: Bulgarian Split Squat
exercises.badminton: Single-leg strength and balance for explosive court movement.
instructions: Rear foot on a bench, front foot a stride ahead.
Lower straight down until the front thigh is near parallel.
Drive up through the front heel. Do both legs.
exercises.tip: Start with bodyweight to find your stance.
mistakes: Front foot too close to the bench.
Pushing off the back foot.
Front knee caving inwards.

exercises.name: Smith Machine Split Squat
exercises.badminton: Stable single-leg strength for lunging to the net.
instructions: Bar on your upper back, take a long split stance under the bar.
Lower straight down until the back knee nearly touches the floor.
Drive up through the front foot. Finish all reps, then switch legs.
exercises.tip: Set the safety stops at your bottom position.
mistakes: Stance so short that the front heel lifts.
Pushing off the back foot.
Front knee caving inwards.

exercises.name: Lateral Lunge
exercises.badminton: Trains the side-lunge used to reach wide shuttles.
instructions: Take a wide step to the side.
Sit back into that hip, keeping the other leg straight.
Push back to the start. Alternate sides.
exercises.tip: Hold a dumbbell at the chest to progress.
mistakes: Bent knee caving inwards.
Lifting the heel of the bent leg.
Rounding the back.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Step-Up
instructions: Stand facing a knee-height box with dumbbells.
Step up and drive through the top foot to stand tall.
Step down with control. Do both legs.
exercises.tip: Don't push off the bottom foot.
mistakes: Pushing off the bottom foot.
Using a box that is too high.
Letting the knee cave inwards.

exercises.name: Single-Leg Romanian Deadlift
exercises.badminton: Builds ankle, knee and hip stability for landings.
instructions: Stand on one leg holding a dumbbell in the opposite hand.
Hinge forward, extending the free leg behind you.
Return to standing. Do both legs.
exercises.tip: Hips stay square to the floor.
mistakes: Letting the hips open up to the side.
Rounding the back.
Rushing and losing balance.

exercises.name: Barbell Hip Thrust
exercises.badminton: Glute power for jumping and quick direction changes.
instructions: Upper back on a bench, bar padded across the hips.
Drive hips up until the body is flat from knees to shoulders.
Lower under control.
exercises.tip: Chin tucked, ribs down at the top.
mistakes: Arching the lower back at the top.
Feet so far forward that the hamstrings take over.
Bench edge too high on the back.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Hip Thrust
instructions: Upper back on a bench, dumbbell on the hips.
Drive hips up and squeeze.
Lower slowly.
exercises.tip: Pause one second at the top.
mistakes: Arching the lower back at the top.
Letting the dumbbell roll around.
Pushing through the toes.

exercises.name: Hip Abduction Machine
exercises.badminton: Hip stability that protects knees in lateral movement.
instructions: Sit with pads on the outside of the knees.
Push knees apart.
Return slowly.
exercises.tip: Lean slightly forward to bias the glutes.
mistakes: Swinging the legs open with momentum.
Letting the pads slam together.
Going too heavy for full range.

exercises.name: Band Lateral Walk
exercises.badminton: Knee and hip stability for side-to-side footwork.
instructions: Place a mini-band above the knees, quarter squat.
Step sideways, keeping tension on the band.
Go 12-15 steps each way.
exercises.tip: Toes point forward.
mistakes: Standing up tall between steps.
Letting the feet come together.
Turning the toes out.

exercises.name: Standing Calf Raise
exercises.badminton: Achilles and calf resilience for jumping and fast footwork.
instructions: Shoulders under the pads, balls of feet on the edge.
Rise as high as possible.
Lower to a full stretch over 2 seconds.
exercises.tip: Pause at the bottom - no bouncing.
mistakes: Bouncing at the bottom.
Cutting the range short.
Bending the knees to push the weight.

exercises.name: Single-Leg Calf Raise
exercises.badminton: Builds ankle stability and Achilles resilience.
instructions: Stand on one foot on a step, holding something for balance.
Rise up as high as possible.
Lower slowly below the step. Do both legs.
exercises.tip: Hold a dumbbell to progress.
mistakes: Rushing the reps.
Not lowering below the step.
Leaning on the support too much.

exercises.name: Box Jump
exercises.badminton: Develops vertical power for jump smashes.
instructions: Stand a step from a low box.
Swing arms and jump, landing softly with knees bent.
Step down - don't jump down.
exercises.tip: Start with a low box. Quality over height.
mistakes: Choosing a box that is too high.
Landing stiff-legged.
Jumping back down instead of stepping.

exercises.name: Skater Jump
exercises.badminton: Lateral explosiveness and landing control for court coverage.
instructions: Balance on one leg.
Bound sideways to land on the opposite leg.
Stick the landing for one second, then bound back.
exercises.tip: Reps are per side. Land quietly.
mistakes: Letting the knee cave on landing.
Not sticking the landing.
Bounding too far too soon.

exercises.name: Pogo Hops
exercises.badminton: Reactive ankle stiffness for quick split-steps.
instructions: Stand tall with soft knees.
Bounce quickly off the balls of your feet.
Minimise ground contact time.
exercises.tip: Think of the floor as hot.
mistakes: Bending the knees a lot on every hop.
Landing on the heels.
Carrying on when the hops get slow.

exercises.name: Hack Squat
instructions: Stand on the platform with your back against the pad and the shoulders under the shoulder pads, feet shoulder-width apart.
Release the safety handles and squat down until the thighs are at least parallel to the platform.
Drive back up without locking the knees, then re-engage the safeties after the last rep.
exercises.tip: Placing the feet a little higher on the platform takes stress off the knees.
mistakes: Letting the heels lift.
Knees caving inwards.
Locking the knees hard at the top.

exercises.name: Barbell Front Squat
instructions: Rack the bar on the front of the shoulders with the elbows high and fingertips under the bar.
Brace and squat down between the heels, keeping the torso upright.
Drive up, leading with the elbows.
exercises.tip: A cross-arm grip is fine if the wrists are tight.
mistakes: Dropping the elbows so the bar rolls forward.
Rounding the upper back.
Letting the heels lift.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Sumo Squat
instructions: Stand with the feet wide and toes turned out, holding one dumbbell by the end between your legs.
Sit straight down, pushing the knees out over the toes.
Stand up by squeezing the glutes and inner thighs.
exercises.tip: Stand on two plates or steps for a deeper range.
mistakes: Knees caving inwards.
Leaning far forward.
A stance so wide that the knees cannot follow the toes.

exercises.name: Single-Leg Leg Press
exercises.badminton: Single-leg pushing strength for explosive lunges and push-offs.
instructions: Sit in the leg press and place one foot in the middle of the platform.
Lower until the knee is about 90 degrees without the hips lifting off the seat.
Press back up without locking the knee. Finish all reps, then switch legs.
exercises.tip: Start with roughly 40 percent of your two-leg weight.
mistakes: Letting the knee cave inwards.
Going so deep that the lower back rounds off the pad.
Locking the knee hard at the top.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Walking Lunge
exercises.badminton: Builds the forward lunge used to reach net shots.
instructions: Stand tall with dumbbells at your sides.
Step forward into a lunge until both knees are about 90 degrees.
Push through the front foot and step straight into the next lunge with the other leg.
exercises.tip: Reps are per leg. Short on space? Lunge forward and step back instead.
mistakes: Short steps that make the front heel lift.
Letting the front knee cave inwards.
Slamming the back knee into the floor.

exercises.name: Smith Machine Reverse Lunge
instructions: Stand under the Smith bar with it across your upper back and the feet under the bar.
Step one foot back and lower until both knees are about 90 degrees.
Drive through the front foot to step back up. Finish all reps, then switch legs.
exercises.tip: The rails take care of balance, so you can focus on the front leg.
mistakes: Stepping back too short.
Pushing off the back foot.
Letting the front knee cave inwards.

exercises.name: Trap-Bar Deadlift
instructions: Stand in the middle of the trap bar with the feet hip-width apart and grip the handles.
Push the hips back, flatten the back and brace, then drive the floor away to stand tall.
Lower by pushing the hips back and bending the knees until the plates touch down.
exercises.tip: The friendliest heavy deadlift - the load stays in line with your body.
mistakes: Rounding the back off the floor.
Jerking the bar instead of pushing smoothly.
Leaning back at the top.

exercises.name: Conventional Deadlift
instructions: Stand with the bar over the middle of the feet, hip-width stance, and grip just outside the legs.
Take the slack out of the bar, brace and push the floor away, keeping the bar against the legs.
Lock out with the glutes, then lower with control along the same path.
exercises.tip: Learn it with light weights - the trap-bar deadlift is the easier start.
mistakes: Rounding the lower back.
Letting the bar drift away from the legs.
Leaning back at the top.

exercises.name: Barbell Good Morning
instructions: Unrack a light bar onto your upper back, feet hip-width apart, knees soft.
Push the hips back and hinge until the torso is nearly parallel or the hamstrings stretch strongly.
Return to standing by driving the hips forward.
exercises.tip: Start very light - it loads the lower back more than it looks.
mistakes: Rounding the back.
Bending the knees into a squat.
Going heavy too soon.

exercises.name: Smith Machine Romanian Deadlift
instructions: Hold the Smith bar at hip height with an overhand grip, feet under the bar.
Push the hips back, sliding the bar down the thighs with a flat back.
Stop at mid-shin or at a strong stretch, then squeeze the glutes to stand up.
exercises.tip: The guided bar lets you learn the hinge safely.
mistakes: Rounding the back.
Squatting down instead of hinging.
Standing too far from the bar.

exercises.name: Sumo Deadlift
instructions: Take a wide stance with the toes turned out and grip the bar inside the knees.
Push the knees out, flatten the back and drive the floor apart to stand up.
Lower with control, keeping the bar close.
exercises.tip: Pick the stance width where your shins are vertical at the start.
mistakes: Knees caving inwards.
Hips shooting up first.
Rounding the back.

exercises.name: Smith Machine Hip Thrust
instructions: Place a bench beside the Smith machine, sit with the upper back on it and the padded bar across the hips.
Unhook the bar and drive the hips up until the body is flat from knees to shoulders.
Lower under control and re-hook the bar after the last rep.
exercises.tip: The rails keep the bar steady - easier to set up than a free barbell.
mistakes: Arching the lower back at the top.
Forgetting to pad the bar.
Feet so far forward that the hamstrings take over.

exercises.name: Cable Glute Kickback
instructions: Strap an ankle cuff to one leg at the low pulley and hold the frame, hinged slightly forward.
Kick the leg back by squeezing the glute, knee slightly bent.
Return slowly. Finish all reps, then switch legs.
exercises.tip: Stop when the hip is straight - kicking higher just arches the back.
mistakes: Arching the lower back to kick higher.
Swinging the leg.
Turning the hips open.

exercises.name: Donkey Kick
instructions: Start on hands and knees with a flat back.
Keeping the knee bent at 90 degrees, push one foot up towards the ceiling.
Lower slowly. Finish all reps, then switch legs.
exercises.tip: Squeeze the glute at the top for a second.
mistakes: Arching the lower back.
Rotating the hips open.
Swinging the leg.

exercises.name: Standing Band Glute Kickback
instructions: Anchor a band low, loop it around one ankle and hold a rack for balance.
Push the leg straight back by squeezing the glute.
Return slowly. Finish all reps, then switch legs.
exercises.tip: Stand tall - only the leg moves.
mistakes: Leaning forward to kick higher.
Arching the lower back.
Letting the band snap the leg back.

exercises.name: Seated Leg Curl
instructions: Sit with the knees in line with the pivot, the roller just above the heels and the thigh pad snug.
Curl the heels down and back as far as possible.
Return slowly over 3 seconds.
exercises.tip: Lean the torso slightly forward for a bigger hamstring stretch.
mistakes: Thigh pad so loose that the hips lift.
Letting the weight snap back.
Knees not lined up with the pivot.

exercises.name: Nordic Hamstring Curl
exercises.badminton: One of the best-proven exercises for preventing hamstring strains in sprint-and-lunge sports.
instructions: Kneel on a mat with the heels anchored under a padded bar or held down by a partner.
Keeping the body straight from knees to head, lean forward as slowly as possible.
Catch yourself with the hands at the bottom and push back up to the start.
exercises.tip: The slow lowering is the exercise - use your hands to get back up.
mistakes: Bending at the hips.
Dropping fast instead of resisting.
Anchoring the heels under something that can slide.

exercises.name: Hip Adduction Machine
exercises.badminton: Strong adductors protect the groin during wide lunges.
instructions: Sit with the pads on the inside of the knees and set a comfortable starting width.
Squeeze the knees together.
Return slowly to the start.
exercises.tip: Start with a narrow range and widen it as you get stronger.
mistakes: Setting the start position too wide.
Letting the pads snap apart.
Leaning back and using momentum.

exercises.name: Cable Hip Adduction
instructions: Strap a cuff to the ankle nearest the low pulley and stand side-on, holding the frame.
Sweep the leg across and in front of the standing leg.
Return slowly. Finish all reps, then switch legs.
exercises.tip: Stand tall - the movement comes from the hip only.
mistakes: Leaning the torso to swing the leg.
Standing too close for any tension.
Rushing the return.

exercises.name: Copenhagen Plank (Short Lever)
exercises.badminton: Proven to cut groin injuries in sports with fast lateral movement.
instructions: Lie on your side next to a bench and rest the inside of the top knee on it, bottom forearm on the mat.
Lift the hips until the body is straight, letting the bottom leg hang free.
Hold, then switch sides.
exercises.tip: Knee on the bench is the beginner version; progress by moving the ankle onto the bench.
mistakes: Letting the hips sag.
Rolling the chest forward.
Holding the breath.

exercises.name: Cable Hip Abduction
instructions: Strap a cuff to the ankle furthest from the low pulley and stand side-on, holding the frame.
Lift the leg out to the side, leading with the heel.
Return slowly. Finish all reps, then switch legs.
exercises.tip: Keep the toes pointing forward to hit the side of the glutes.
mistakes: Leaning away to lift higher.
Turning the toes up to the ceiling.
Swinging the leg.

exercises.name: Side-Lying Hip Abduction
instructions: Lie on your side with the bottom knee bent and the top leg straight, in line with the body.
Lift the top leg towards the ceiling, leading with the heel and keeping the toes pointing forward.
Lower slowly. Finish all reps, then switch sides.
exercises.tip: A small lift done strictly beats a big swing - you should feel the side of the hip burn.
mistakes: Rolling the hips backwards to lift higher.
Turning the toes up to the ceiling.
Swinging the leg instead of lifting it.

exercises.name: Seated Calf Raise
exercises.badminton: Bent-knee calf work strengthens the soleus, which protects the Achilles.
instructions: Sit with the knee pad snug on the thighs and the balls of the feet on the edge of the step.
Lower the heels to a full stretch, then rise as high as possible.
Pause at the top and at the bottom.
exercises.tip: Slow, full reps - this muscle loves time under tension.
